verdict.rationale: Mercury documents invoicing: manual and automatic invoices, an Accounts Receivable API, and payment-status tracking via webhooks and events. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic reminders or follow-ups for overdue invoices. "Automatic invoices" covers sending invoices, not chasing unpaid ones. The AR API and webhooks are developer building blocks someone could use to build follow-ups, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have overdue invoices automatically followed up on without manual chasing
